## MaxTube release

- YouTube: `%yt_version%`
- YTKACE: `%ytkace_version%`
- iOS/iPadOS: 15.0 or the base IPA minimum when higher
- tvOS: unsupported

This build uses the open-source YTKACE downloader in place of YTLite 5.2.2.
The IPA must still be signed for your device. YTKACE licensing and attribution
are provided beside the release artifact.
